title: C debugging tasks with three error-message variants
summary: Students debug six faulty C programs in a within-subjects lab study. Each task presents either a stock GCC message, an expert-written explanation, or a pre-generated GPT-4 explanation; external AI tools are prohibited during the exercise.

sources.title: Not the Silver Bullet: LLM-enhanced Programming Error Messages are Ineffective in Practice
sources.evidence_quote: students were tasked to fix six buggy C programs

assessment.summary: Fix six C programs that each contain a compile-time error.
student_actions: Inspect the assigned error message or explanation.
Edit and run the program until the compiler error is fixed.
Submit the corrected program or skip after five minutes.

student_role.description: Two of six tasks displayed a GPT-4-generated error explanation; students could not use ChatGPT or Copilot themselves.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 106 students completed all six tasks in a scheduled lab; GPT-4 was faster than GCC on only one task, while handwritten explanations performed best.

evidence_excerpts.quote: students were tasked to fix six buggy C programs
